query: Before we publish this landing page, check it against our brand guidelines and tell me everything that's wrong.
Our agency just sent over the new trade-show banner. Is it on-brand?
Run a brand consistency check on our app's stylesheet. I suspect people have been sneaking in random greys and blues.
Brand QA on these five Instagram posts please, guidelines attached. Tell me what must be fixed versus what's just taste.
Roast our homepage headline and CTA. It gets traffic but it's not converting.
Check whether our new palette passes WCAG contrast and fix the shades that fail.
Write the brand guidelines document from the colors, fonts and logo we've already decided.
